categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: outdoor products and chip business. The outdoor segment focuses on the design, development, and sales of outdoor apparel, footwear, backpacks, tents, sleeping bags, and mountaineering equipment. The chip segment involves touch IC design, Mini LED display driver IC design, chip packaging and testing, and related technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The outdoor business leverages proprietary polar bionic technology platforms and advanced functional fabrics such as TiEF and SAFree for footwear soles. The chip business specializes in On-Cell single-layer touch IC technology, Mini LED active matrix display driver ICs, and advanced packaging technologies including wafer-level and ceramic packaging. Production is mainly outsourced with a focus on design and R&D in-house.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include outdoor enthusiasts across various age groups, with products targeting professional mountaineering, hiking, skiing, and camping markets. The chip business serves major panel manufacturers and end markets such as notebooks, smartphones, automotive displays, and industrial infrared imaging. Major clients include Samsung, LG, BOE, and Leyard.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive retail presence across major regions including North China, South China, East China, Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, and Central China. It also has overseas operations and customers in Mongolia, Malaysia, Nepal, UAE, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Kyrgyzstan, South Korea, and the US. The chip business has subsidiaries in South Korea and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: In the outdoor segment, the company operates primarily downstream, focusing on product design, brand marketing, and retail, with manufacturing outsourced. In the chip segment, it covers midstream to downstream activities including chip design, packaging, testing, and sales, with wafer fabrication outsourced to foundries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance materials, smart outdoor equipment, and sustainable green technologies in outdoor products. In chips, it focuses on advanced process nodes, high-performance touch ICs, Mini LED display drivers, automotive-grade chips, and vertical integration of design, packaging, and testing. It also pursues global expansion and ecosystem collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of outdoor apparel, footwear, and equipment, as well as sales of semiconductor chips and related solutions. Sales channels include direct retail, franchise, online e-commerce platforms, and B2B group purchases. The chip business uses direct sales and distributor models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In outdoor products, the company is a leading domestic brand competing with international and local brands, recognized for technology and professional quality. In chips, it competes with global leaders in touch IC and display driver IC markets, holding a strong position in China with proprietary technologies and expanding market share internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, a 14.44% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 106.6 million, up 48.5%. The chip segment grew 66.56% in revenue and 183.3% in net profit. The company has about 595 employees and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a steady growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through its proprietary polar bionic technology platform, high-performance and sustainable materials, and integration of smart outdoor equipment. Its chip business offers advanced On-Cell touch ICs and Mini LED active matrix drivers with patented technologies, providing high precision, energy efficiency, and customization. The brand is positioned as professional, technological, and fashionable, with strong national project endorsements enhancing credibility.
